citation: IBPSA Modelica Library, https://github.com/ibpsa/modelica-ibpsa (developed through IEA EBC Annex 60 and IBPSA Project 1)
description: The Modelica IBPSA Library is a free, open-source library of basic Modelica models that codify best practice for building and community energy and control systems: fluid flow, heat transfer, storage, controls and weather-data components. It is produced by the International Building Performance Simulation Association's Modelica Working Group, and was developed from 2012 to 2017 in Annex 60 of the IEA Energy in Buildings and Communities Programme and from 2017 to 2022 in IBPSA Project 1, so that several national libraries share one validated core. It is generic in scope and is typically not used directly by end users: it is integrated by developers of the four sister libraries AixLib (RWTH Aachen), Buildings (LBNL), BuildingSystems (UdK Berlin) and IDEAS (KU Leuven), which distribute it to their users. It is distributed as Modelica source on GitHub; the latest tag is v3.0.0 and development continued in September 2026. Licence: 3-clause BSD, free. Caveat: as a core library it offers building blocks, not complete building models, and needs a Modelica tool. Simulation uses are component-level physics for capacity planning and district network flow models. Related records: Modelica Buildings Library, AixLib, IDEAS and BuildingSystems, which extend it; TEASER, which generates models for these libraries.
